This substantive recovery commit permits a controlled attempt using a fresh deployment identity; it does not claim a proven backend root cause.

Validation: 14 focused tests cover byte limits, missing index, symlinks/hardlinks, special files, optimized-mode refusal, diagnostic timeout, and secret omission. Existing publication payload passes. Separate AI review and required CI are required before merge.
